{{Quote|Animals are so innocent, so sweet. And If I don't look after them, who will? I just hope my chickens aren't too upset when I take their eggs.|Marnie}}

'''Marnie''' is a [[Villagers|villager]] who lives at [[Marnie's Ranch]] in the northeast area of [[Cindersap Forest]], near the southwest entrance to [[Pelican Town]].

Marnie runs her own shop at Marnie's Ranch from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM each day, except Monday and Tuesday, although the building is still open on these days. She sells [[animals]] and animal supplies.

==Schedule==
After the [[Ginger Island#Beach Resort|Beach Resort]] on Ginger Island is unlocked, Marnie may randomly spend Monday and/or Tuesday there. After leaving the Island at 6pm, Marnie will immediately go home to bed. Marnie never visits the Resort on [[Festivals|Festival]] days.

Shown below is Marnie's schedule, prioritized from the top down.  For example, if it is raining, that schedule overrides all schedules below it.

==Relationships==
Marnie lives with her niece, [[Jas]], and her nephew, [[Shane]].  When it is not raining, she exercises with [[Caroline]], [[Jodi]], [[Emily]], and [[Robin]] on Tuesdays at [[Pierre's General Store]].

[[Lewis|Mayor Lewis]] and Marnie have a very close relationship. Although Marnie claims to be single during the [[Flower Dance]], Lewis and Marnie's 6-heart event confirms that they are dating.  Lewis visits Marnie's Ranch to attend to her "business needs" on occasion, and the two can often be found drinking together at [[the Stardrop Saloon]] in the evening.  In one of the [[Quests#Mayor's &ldquo;Shorts&rdquo;|story quests]], Lewis asks you to find his lucky purple shorts, which can be found in Marnie's bedroom.

==Heart Events==
===Anytime===
At any [[friendship]] level greater than zero friendship points, you may receive a gift in the mail from Marnie.  The chance of receiving a gift in the mail increases as your friendship with Marnie increases.
{|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
! style="text-align: left;" | '''Details'''&nbsp;
|-                            
| 
	{|class="wikitable roundedborder"
	|-
	!Item
	!Description
	|-
	|{{Name|Hay|30}}
	|Dear ''(Name)'',<p>You're such a good neighbor I thought I'd send over some animal feed to make your job easier. Keep it up!</p><p>-Marnie</p>
	|}
|}

===Three Hearts I===
{{heart event
 |hearts  = 3
 |trigger = Leave your [[farmhouse]] between 6am - 9:30am.
 |details = Marnie greets the player as they come out of the [[farmhouse]]. She will tell the player that she is trying to train her goats to say "hello" but they will not cooperate unless she has their favorite food, [[Cave Carrot]]s. Marnie asks the player to bring one to her ranch between 9 AM and 5 PM. If the player enters [[Marnie's Ranch]] during that time (opening hours may contradict this) with a [[Cave Carrot]] in their inventory, a cutscene will occur with the player giving Marnie the carrot. This cutscene will trigger regardless of whether or not Marnie is home.
}}

===Three Hearts II===
{{heart event
 |hearts  = 3
 |trigger = After reaching 3 hearts, Marnie sends you a recipe in the mail.
 |details =
<table class="wikitable roundedborder">
  <tr>
    <th>Image</th>
    <th>Recipe</th>
    <th>Description</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
     <td>{{Recipe|Pale Broth|48}}</td>
     <td>[[Pale Broth]]</td>
     <td>Dear neighbor,<p>when I'm not taking care of animals I like to experiment in the kitchen. Since we've become friends I want to share some recipes with you.</p><p>I hope you like this!</p><p>-Marnie</p></td>
  </tr>
</table>
}}

===Six Hearts===
{{heart event
 |hearts  = 6
 |trigger = On a sunny day, enter the town between 7pm and 11pm.<p>Note: Only happens if [[Lewis]] is also at 6 hearts.</p>
 |details = You will appear behind Lewis' house.  Lewis and Marnie are talking by the river about making their romance public.  Lewis says it would undermine his authority, while Marnie says he's too concerned for his job.  In the end, Marnie says she'll keep their relationship a secret.  Afterwards, you'll pop up and scare both Lewis and Marnie.  Lewis asks you if you heard anything, and you are presented with a choice.
*{{Choice|Yes... but I'll keep it a secret.|50|Lewis}}
*{{Choice|Yes... and I'm going to tell everyone.|-100|Lewis}}

If you choose to keep the secret, Lewis will thank you.  If you say you'll tell everyone in town, Lewis will cry.  Afterwards, Marnie will ask why you were behind the house, and your character will run away, leaving the two alone and confused.
}}

'''First Meeting'''

{{Squote|Ah, Mayor Lewis told me you just arrived. I'm Marnie! I sell livestock and animal care products at my ranch. You should swing by some time.}}

'''Regular'''
{{Squote|I love animals, [Mr./Ms] [Player]. If you treat yours well I'm sure we'll become good friends!}}
{{Squote|Animals are so innocent, so sweet. And If I don't look after them, who will? I just hope my chickens aren't too upset when I take their eggs.}}
{{Squote|You've been here a while, now... how's your farm doing? Taking care of animals is easy as long as you don't forget about them!}}
{{Squote|My nephew Shane has been staying at my place the last few months. He helps me out with the chickens, so I'm not complaining.}}
{{Squote|You can use a scythe to cut feed from grass. Or you can buy it from me, of course! I could use the cash... Adios.}}
{{Squote|Hi. Need something? I might be getting some different kinds of animals in the future. Although, I'll need to make sure there's a market for them, so you'll have to prove your skill with animals first. Just keep treating your animals with respect and good things will happen.}}
{{Squote|You can catch me at the saloon most nights. Animals are great company, but I need to spend some time with people, too.}}
{{Squote|I think someone in town has taken a liking to me. *teehee*}}
{{Squote|I would be so lonely if Shane ever moved out.}}
{{Squote|Have you been to that strange tower west of my house? One time I heard this terrible, otherworldly noise coming from there. I would avoid that place if I were you...}}
{{Squote|Hey there, it's good to see ya! Feel free to visit us any time you please.}}

''Rainy Days''
{{Squote|Hi [Player]. You look like you're soaked...you poor thing!}}

''6+ Hearts''
{{Squote|I wonder if Mr. Lewis gets lonely in that big house of his... It seems so empty in there, doesn't it?}}

''8+ Hearts''
{{Squote|Hi [Player]! I'm glad we've become friends. I know I can trust you to take care of my dear animals.}}

'''At the Saloon'''
{{Squote|Now that I'm here I can finally relax and socialize a bit.}}
{{Squote|There aren't very many people here today...}}
{{Squote|I spilled a whole bucket of milk on the floor today, it was horrible. And such a waste of my poor Belinda's hard work.}}
{{Squote|It's nice of you to show up! It's a little more lively now.}}
{{Squote|Phew! It sure feels good to kick back after a hard day's work.}}
{{Squote|*sigh*... I wasn't very productive today.}}
{{Squote|I always see Clint here but he won't talk to anyone. He just glances over his shoulder now and then.}}
{{Squote|(Marnie doesn't seem to notice that you're there...)}}

''If you are to examine Marnie's trash can whilst she is in the same room, she asks''
{{Squote|Why are you looking through my trash can?}} (Marnie will not display this message when you look through her trash can beside the coop or the door that [[Jas]] shows you in [[Shane]]'s 8 heart event.)

'''Doctor Visit'''
{{Squote|Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?}}

'''Green Rain'''
''Year 1''
{{Squote|You're not worried about this rain? That does put me at ease a little... I just hope the cows tucked themselves in...}}
''Year 2+''
{{Squote|The animals seems to enjoy this rain... I think it's putting extra nutrients into the grass.}}
''Green rain finished (next day)''
{{Squote|Well, looks like we all got scared for nothing... The rain was totally harmless!}}

'''At Ginger Island'''
{{Squote|Hehe... finally a chance to show off all my hard work at aerobics club.}}
{{Squote|Hee hee... It's interesting to see everyone in their bathing suits.}}
{{Squote|Ew... the chair's wet.}}
{{Squote|Phew... It's hot!}}
{{Squote|I feel warm.}}

{{Squote|I'm so happy you moved here, and that you two get along so well!}}

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Cow's Delight|"Cow's Delight"]]: On the 3rd of [[Fall]], Marnie will send you a letter requesting a single bunch of [[Amaranth]].  The reward is {{Price|500}} and 1 [[Friendship]] heart.
*Marnie may randomly request an item at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]].  The reward is 3x the item's base value and 150 [[Friendship]] points.

==Trivia==
* When choosing the "Supplies Shop", there is a 0.01% chance for the text under Marnie's portrait to read "*sigh*... When the door opened I thought it might be Lewis."
* Marnie will still tell the player that Shane has lived with her for the past few months, even if they are married to Shane or have lived in the Valley for years.
